dashboard.title: Farmer Dashboard

aiScanner.title: AI Cattle Disease Scanner
aiScanner.subtitle: Upload a photo of your cattle's affected area or symptoms for immediate preliminary AI screening.
aiScanner.disclaimer: Medical Disclaimer: AI diagnostic screening provides preliminary guidance and does not replace professional examination by a licensed veterinarian.
aiScanner.symptomsPlaceholder: e.g., High fever, skin nodules, loss of appetite, decreased milk yield...

aiScanner.symptomsHelp: Please record observed signs, behavioral changes, or affected areas to aid diagnostic accuracy.

scanHistory.title: Disease Scan History
scanHistory.subtitle: Review all past AI diagnostic screenings, timeline logs, and veterinarian consultation statuses.

scanHistory.caseQueuedNotice: This case is currently queued. A licensed veterinarian will review the scan and add professional clinical advice shortly.
scanHistory.disclaimerBottom: AI results are for initial screening. Always consult a veterinarian for critical livestock health decisions.

medicineRequests.title: My Medicine Orders

medicinesPage.uploadPrompt: Drag & drop your prescription image or PDF here
medicinesPage.uploadDesc: Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP and PDF files up to 10MB.
